answered.sql: SELECT AB.name, U.description FROM Apartment_Buildings AB JOIN Apartment_Buildings_Units ABU ON AB.id = ABU.building_id JOIN Units U ON ABU.unit_id = U.id

candidates.meaning: For each apartment building, list the unit descriptions associated with the units in that building.

candidates.meaning: Find the unit descriptions for each apartment building.
